verified_title: RAN-JEPA: An Action-Conditioned World Model for Energy-efficient Mobile Network Control
metadata_description: Abstract page for arXiv paper 2610.17584: RAN-JEPA: An Action-Conditioned World Model for Energy-efficient Mobile Network Control
method_summary: Observation-only predictive pretraining and deployment adaptation precede learning action-conditioned latent transitions with a frozen encoder. The transition is residual in latent space; the numeric head adds a learned correction to a mechanistic action-aware reference. A calibrated twin compares SLEEP and KEEP from the same pre-action history.
direct_overlap: same downstream controller across predictive models
evidence_and_limits: Real-equipment four-cell 5G testbed, public operator pretraining, and 15-minute energy/congestion horizons. The what-if reference is a calibrated digital twin. This is not a warehouse Wi-Fi packet-deadline experiment; the reported control comparison is descriptive, not a universal significance or superiority claim.
